Visibility.Name: Who can see the popup
Visibility.Hint: Controls which users get the hover popup at all. When set to GM only, players never see it.

HideFromPlayers.Name: Hide details from players until revealed
HideFromPlayers.Hint: When enabled, players see ??? for each section of the popup until the GM reveals that section for that specific creature using the eye buttons on the GM's popup.

ObscureInfo.Name: Obscure Info
ObscureInfo.Hint: Only applies while "Hide details from players until revealed" is on. Revealed saving throws show their rank relative to the creature's other two saves (Highest, Middle, Lowest, Highest (2), Lowest (2), or Equal) instead of the exact modifier. Unrevealed saves still show ???.

GranularInfo.Name: Granular Info
GranularInfo.Hint: Only applies while "Hide details from players until revealed" is on. The GM can click individual saving throws and individual immunity, weakness, and resistance entries in their popup to reveal just those entries to players, leaving the rest hidden. The section eye button still reveals the whole section at once.
